name: escalation-v2-sharepoint-provisioning

scripts.purpose: Create Escalations_v2_* lists/columns/indexes/views on an approved non-production test site (dry-run by default).
Read-only validation of the test site against the schema.
Delete only Escalations_v2_* lists on the test site (requires allowCleanup=true).
Shared fail-closed safety helpers (config load, safety gate, schema plan).

prerequisite: PnP.PowerShell module + interactive auth at runtime; scripts fail closed with a prerequisite message if absent (no auto-install, no faking).
notes: No secrets, tenant IDs, client IDs, or live URLs are stored here. Real runtime config must never be committed. See SHAREPOINT_V2_PROVISIONING_SAFETY_CHECKLIST.md.
